entries.to: Things people often tell us in a first session

entries.prefix: "I wish I could stop worrying constantly
entries.to: "I can’t turn my brain off at night. Every small thing turns into a worst-case scenario."

entries.prefix: "The most ordinary thing I've lost that most people would understand
entries.to: "I used to love my job. Now I feel tired all the time, even after a weekend off."

entries.prefix: "One thing I wish I could let go of as a caregiver
entries.to: "We keep having the same argument, and neither of us knows how to stop it."

entries.prefix: "The most ordinary thing I've lost that most people wouldn't understand
entries.to: "Since the loss, everyone expects me to be fine again. Most days I’m just going through the motions."

entries.prefix: "Living with my illness sounds like screaming
entries.to: "My teenager barely talks to me anymore, and I can’t tell if it’s a phase or something more."

entries.prefix: "I always felt like a bad person because
entries.to: "I’ve been holding it together for everyone else for so long. I’m not sure who looks after me."
